#!/usr/bin/env python3
import ldap
import sqlite3
import sys

def sync_users_from_ldap(ldap_server, ldap_user, ldap_password, db_path):
    # Connect to LDAP server
    try:
        conn = ldap.initialize(f'ldap://{ldap_server}')
        conn.simple_bind_s(ldap_user, ldap_password)
    except ldap.INVALID_CREDENTIALS:
        print('LDAP authentication failed')
        return False
    
    # Query LDAP for users
    search_filter = '(objectClass=inetOrgPerson)'
    results = conn.search_s('cn=users,dc=company,dc=local', ldap.SCOPE_SUBTREE, search_filter)
    
    # Connect to local database
    db = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    cursor = db.cursor()
    
    # Sync users to database
    for dn, attrs in results:
        if dn is None:
            continue
        username = attrs.get('uid', [b''])[0].decode()
        email = attrs.get('mail', [b''])[0].decode()
        full_name = attrs.get('cn', [b''])[0].decode()
        
        # Insert or update user record
        query = f"INSERT OR REPLACE INTO users (username, email, name) VALUES ('{username}', '{email}', '{full_name}')"
        cursor.execute(query)
    
    db.commit()
    db.close()
    conn.unbind_s()
    return True

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sync_users_from_ldap('ldap.company.local', 'admin@company', 'AdminPass123', '/var/lib/sync.db')
